name: omnipost
description: Windows desktop publishing workspace for adapting and delivering content across platforms.

scripts.build: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-toolchain.ts && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && electron-vite build
scripts.test:e2e: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-toolchain.ts && electron-vite build && playwright test --config=tests/e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:browser:e2e: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-toolchain.ts && cross-env OMNIPOST_BROWSER_E2E=1 vitest run src/main/browser/assisted-browser-engine.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
scripts.package:dir: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-toolchain.ts && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win dir
scripts.package: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-toolchain.ts && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win nsis && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/package-smoke/run.ts
scripts.typecheck: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-toolchain.ts && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json
scripts.verify: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-toolchain.ts && eslint . && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && vitest run && electron-vite build
